title: BELOW_BUYER_THRESHOLD terminal status + 4-concept separation
scope: MINIMAL — only two changes, no other protocol modifications

changes.definition: BELOW_BUYER_THRESHOLD: hard gates (Patent + Evidence) PASS, but any soft gate FAILS OR composite < 70. Distinct from WOULD_NOT_PAY (hard gates fail). Distinct from WOULD_CONSIDER_WITH_MILESTONES (all gates pass + composite >= 70).
changes.rationale: V3 FINAL exposed a case where hard gates passed but soft gates failed. Calling this WOULD_NOT_PAY is misleading — the IP is proven, the engineering just needs physical validation. BELOW_BUYER_THRESHOLD is the honest intermediate state.

changes.v1_0: Single 'final_status' field derived from gate results
changes.v1_1:
4 conceptual fields + derived final_status:
  - PATENT_STATUS (102 + 103 state)
  - ENGINEERING_STATUS (TECHNICAL + SAFETY gate state)
  - BUYER_SENTIMENT (blind test result + source)
  - BUYER_READINESS (mechanical: READY if all gates pass + composite >= 70, else NOT_READY)
  - final_status (deterministically derived from the above per state machine)
changes.diff: ADD: 4 conceptual fields; final_status becomes derived, not chosen
changes.rationale: Conflating sentiment with readiness caused the V3 FINAL silent-promotion bug. Separating them makes the machine honest.

what_does_NOT_change: §14 protocol evolution workflow — unchanged (this PCP uses it)
constitutional_invariants_preserved: Non-compensable status of Patent and Evidence gates (§7.2)
approval_required_from: CEO (not the agent who filed PCP-001)
if_approved: V1.1 constitution created; CONSTITUTION_REGISTRY.json updated; all future inventions declare protocol_version=V1.1
if_rejected: V1.0 remains; BELOW_BUYER_THRESHOLD maps to WOULD_NOT_PAY (current behavior)

deterministic_state_machine.rule_2: Hard gates pass + (any soft gate fail OR composite < 70) → BELOW_BUYER_THRESHOLD (V1.1) / WOULD_NOT_PAY (V1.0)
deterministic_state_machine.rule_3: All gates pass + composite >= 70 + milestones remain → WOULD_CONSIDER_WITH_MILESTONES
deterministic_state_machine.rule_4: All gates pass + composite >= 70 + no required milestones → LEVEL_4_BUYER_READY
